An '''officer''' was in charge of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]]. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] assigned [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Travi Pott]] and [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Travi Pott's squad|squad]] to destroy [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist]] [[Jammer/Legends|jamming beacons]] on [[Savrip Island]]. After the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] suffered heavy casualties, Sergeant Pott believed that the officer was incompetent.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />
